EFS/S18.title: Android debug build on the local stack: permissions, offline at an AI step, empty / failure states (carried from e02167f; iOS and state 3 left)
EFS/S18.detail: Not re-run on 43c38a4f: the Android rig (debug build bundled for the local stack, rc_api36 emulator) was built from e02167f and is not rebuilt in this package. The device lane's 10-15 05:18Z verdict (17/25 judged, 8 fail: camera denied shows no message 3/3; the camera never opens, Android's photo picker does 3/3; offline Save Note in the fullscreen editor spins 'Saving & Updating…' with the offline banner hidden behind the editor) is carried because none of those code paths changed (efs-s18-pre-codepath.txt: android/, ios/, capacitor.config.ts, PreRoundNotesEditor / Card, the connection and dictation code in src/lib, the scan lists and components/clinical unchanged; the only changes in touched folders are templates.ts, useLocalDay.ts, scannedPatient.ts's empty vitals and PreviousNotesPanel's blank-date flag). Known: N9, N10, N12 (TFA-92570 / TFA-94745), plus B27's 'Dictation done' line. Left, blocked: the TFA-92588 part — state 3 (summary failed: error shown, Generate disabled) on a phone was not exercised by the device lane, and the whole iOS half; both need a 43c38a4f debug build on a device or emulator (real-device session). In a desktop browser state 3 passes on 43c38a4f in both modes (EFS/S07, TC-10/S11, S12, S26 R1).
EFS/S18.productIssue: On Android (e02167f build, code unchanged in 43c38a4f): with camera permission denied the scan and Photograph buttons do nothing and show no message; with it granted they open the photo picker instead of the camera; an offline Save Note in the fullscreen pre-round editor shows an endless spinner while the offline banner is hidden behind the editor.
